- **Your email address**, or
- Your **first name + last name + zip code**

Once I have that, I can look up your order and confirm the return for the two skateboards and refund it to your **credit card**.
Sure, my name is Mei Ahmed and my zip code is 78705. I actually have a couple more items I’d like to return as well, but let’s start with this.
